notes.title: Final Discount Before Removal and Some Changes to Level 1
notes.content:
I would like to announce that this is the final discount before the game is removed from Steam on September 15, 2025.

The game will still be playable for everyone who purchased it, even after it is removed from the store.

Additionally, I’ve made some changes to Level 1 to make it easier.

Thanks,

notes.title: Rolly will be removed from Steam on September 15, 2025.
notes.content:
I would like to announce that Rolly will be removed from Steam on September 15, 2025.

The game will still be playable for those who purchased it, even after it is removed.

Sadly, the game did not succeed, and I don’t think it’s worth keeping it on Steam.
